result_text:
I fixed the four broken default scoping conventions in `ScopingConventions.java`. The full `codeanalyzer` test suite passes offline (334 run, 0 failures, 3 skipped).

Changes, all in `codeanalyzer/src/main/java/nl/obren/sokrates/sourcecode/scoping/ScopingConventions.java`:

- **Generated HTML (pkgdown, Doxygen, meta generator):** the path pattern is now `.*[.](htm|html|xhtml)`, so `.htm` pages are covered.
- **.NET `<doc>` XML:** `.*/[.]xml` → `.*[.]xml`. The old pattern required a `/` directly before `.xml`, so it never matched anything.
- **JS `// Generated by …`:** `.*/[.]js` → `.*[.]js`, for the same reason.
- **Gradle JS build scripts:** `.*[.][-]gradle[.]js` → `.*[-]gradle[.]js`, so `build-gradle.js` matches.

I also added `codeanalyzer/src/test/java/nl/obren/sokrates/sourcecode/scoping/ScopingConventionsTest.java`. It checks that the new patterns match the intended files (`.htm` pkgdown/Doxygen/meta pages, `MyAssembly.xml` with `<doc>`, `app.js` with a generator comment, `build-gradle.js`). It also checks that the old matches still work (`.html` Doxygen, `.xhtml` meta, `build.gradle`) and that hand-written `.htm`, `.xml` and `.js` files stay out.

Nothing was committed.
